subject: economics
evidence: Speech-to-text (faster-whisper small, CPU) of the reference narration, read in excerpts, plus voice-activity timing of all 37 videos. The transcripts are rough: Hinglish terms come out misspelt and quiet or music stretches produce repeated words, so marker-word counts were not reliable and are not used; the moves below were read by hand and each one names where it was heard.

voice_timing.note: The references talk almost without pauses. BIE keeps the slower gaps Navin passed in Money v2 (0.28 s between sentences, 0.45 s between lines, 0.9 s between scenes) because the picture needs the time to act.

moves.move: Open with a small scene or story before any term
moves.how: a short role-play or situation the learner knows (bargaining for a loan like buying vegetables; a trading company that cannot carry cash safely); the term is named only after the scene has shown the problem
one line at the start: 'आज हम बात करेंगे …', then the road map appears

moves.move: Unpack every term in plain words with 'यानी'
moves.how: term → यानी → everyday meaning → who uses it (BPLR यानी वह दर जो बैंक अपने सबसे भरोसेमंद ग्राहक से लेता है)
moves.same_as_v2_rule: every English term opened in plain Hindi the first time

moves.move: Talk to the learner as 'आप' and 'हम'
moves.how: puts the learner inside the example: 'आपके और हमारे जैसे लोग जो पैसा बैंक में जमा करते हैं …'

moves.move: Walk a cause chain step by step, then name it
moves.how: if the loan does not come back → the bank cannot return deposits → the bank closes → this is why it is called credit risk
a what-if that changes one thing (suddenly a recession comes, shares fall, everyone runs to safe government bonds) and follows its effect

moves.move: Small made-up numbers carry the idea
moves.how: a hypothetical case with round numbers (₹10 lakh loan at 15%, 12%, 7%; per-person income halves) before any real data

moves.move: Close each step with 'तो यहाँ एक बात साफ़ हो गई …'
moves.how: after the evidence, one sentence states the conclusion before moving on

moves.move: Benefit or harm in human terms
moves.how: what the person feels or gets: after buying protection 'आप चैन की नींद सो सकते हैं'; if a bank fails 'बैंक पर ताला लग जाता है'
'चलिए अब बात करते हैं अगले …' at each branch, while the road map moves

do_not_copy: Long lists of reasons read out while text boxes fill the screen (E21 293-365 s, E34 55-127 s).

Facts stated by the references without checking (several were doubtful: the Act under which CRR is kept, who bought the associate banks' stake, 'fully private central bank'). BIE takes facts from the book.
Channel promotion, app adverts and end screens.
